column5: Vault._settle credits coordinator profit shares to storage via _credit while _saveContext later overwrites the same account with the stale in-memory local, so anyone calling settle(coordinator) erases the coordinator profit shares and desyncs total shares.

MakerStrategyLib._allocateMarket divides by the unchecked oracle latestPrice, so a registered market with zero latest price makes every allocate-routed deposit, redeem and rebalance revert, freezing the vault.
